title: Portability and self-propulsion audit for everyday intergenerational reciprocal exchange
purpose: Test whether the shared relationship-layer hypothesis can become a regenerative value field rather than remaining institution-bound community programming.
governing_truth: INSTITUTIONAL BACKING MAY BE STRUCTURAL NOT TEMPORARY

evidence.fact: A current 2026 Beijing report records volunteers asking whether saved service time will remain redeemable years later and what happens if they move to another community; legal commentary recommends unified city-level transferability and government credit backing.
Current 2026 research based on Nanjing/Shanghai practice identifies barriers to universal deposit/redemption as a direct cause of liquidity blockage and weak long-term trust.

Zhangjiagang's public time-bank rules show an example of locality-bound value: when a participant moves household registration out of the city, the account is closed and time credits are converted to a one-off cash subsidy rather than remaining portable service claims.

portability.interpretation: The reciprocal asset is often valid only inside the institution/community that issued it. Moving across geography or governance boundaries can reset or extinguish the claim. This weakens the promise that present contribution creates durable future reciprocal rights.

evidence.fact: Current 2026 time-bank research reports insufficient internal momentum caused by participant-structure imbalance, weak credit guarantees and quality-standard gaps.

A 2026 academic review of mutual-aid eldercare says many pilots have existed for more than a decade but large-scale sustainable expansion remains elusive, with many projects remaining demonstration-style sites.

Historical field research documents organizer withdrawal failure: after a professional social-work team exited a time-bank pilot at the end of its service term, some community activity degraded and communication channels became inactive.
evidence.evidence_role: historical mechanism evidence, not current prevalence proof

self_propulsion.interpretation: Current evidence does not show that the relationship network naturally continues after organizer stimulus. In many implementations, the organizer is part of the production function rather than merely a launch catalyst.

evidence.fact: Current Beijing participants identify future redeemability itself as the core confidence problem: they may contribute now but cannot know whether enough future providers, useful redemption options or institutional continuity will exist.
Current research describes weak credit guarantees, limited universal redemption and service-quality inconsistency as barriers to turning accumulated time into credible future rights.
Research on time-bank startup logic identifies unstable participant expectations, weak trust, uneven value measurement and fragmented management as recurring structural problems.

credit_and_liquidity.interpretation: The deeper resource may not be 'points'. It may be a credible portable claim on future reciprocal capacity, backed by standards, quality, liquidity and institutional continuity.

classes.name: high-trust / high-liability reciprocal life support
classes.conclusion: These domains likely require persistent institutional or regulated trust anchors. Full peer-to-peer self-propulsion may be undesirable because privacy, child safety, housing and liability rules are structural.

classes.name: lower-risk reciprocal capability exchange
domains: LWF-003 skills / local-life knowledge / digital help
classes.conclusion: This domain has fewer safety constraints and is the cleaner place to test whether portable reputation, reciprocal records and repeated local exchange can become self-propelling outside a heavy institution.

layered_hypothesis.caution: This is a structural hypothesis, not a product architecture.

evidence.fact: Fengtai's 2026 silver-capability program includes not only crafts but retired engineers delivering aerospace science education, suggesting the hidden-capability problem extends beyond physical handicrafts.
A September 2026 Hangzhou pilot trains older adults to turn accumulated experience into callable AI Skills; examples include cooking experience and family-education knowledge.

value_translation_parallel_check.interpretation: The underlying formation may be broader: retirement strands useful experience in forms that modern distribution/software cannot call directly, while digital/AI tooling can reduce conversion cost. Young-digital participation is still only partially evidenced in this broader form, so no intergenerational commercial thesis is promoted.

decisive_learning: The relationship archetype's hardest problem is not initial matching. It is continuity of trust and reciprocity across time, place and organizer boundaries.
A local community can manufacture trust through social capital, but that trust often does not travel.
A ledger can record contribution without guaranteeing future liquidity, quality or redemption.
For high-risk domains, persistent institutional backing may be a feature rather than a removable friction.
The cleanest test bed for self-propelling intergenerational reciprocity is lower-risk skill/local-life exchange, not childcare or housing.
LWA-VALUE-TRANSLATION may extend beyond crafts into knowledge/experience digitization, but the role of younger counterparts and recurring commercial demand remain unbound.

active_archetype_hypotheses: LWA-VALUE-TRANSLATION hidden capability to modern market/callable form

next_action: Deepen LWA-R2 first. Search for repeated low-risk, non-kin intergenerational skill/local-life exchanges that persist beyond one organizer-led event, create repeat pairings or referrals, carry reputation across encounters, and show a recurring reason people return. Separately, test whether LWA-VALUE-TRANSLATION appears in everyday non-craft domains with actual repeated value capture. Do not design a platform, set prices or contact actors.
